en-US.author: PTV Planung Transport Verkehr GmbH
en-US.longDescription: PTV Viswalk, the microscopic pedestrian simulation software, depicts pedestrians and their interaction with each other. The software enables urban and traffic planners, fire safety officers, and managers of railway stations, airports, and event venues to effectively model and solve pedestrian interaction challenges.
en-US.name: PTV Viswalk

zh-CN.longDescription: PTV Viswalk 是一款微观行人模拟软件，可刻画行人及其相互之间的作用。该软件帮助城市与交通规划师、消防安全人员以及火车站、机场和活动场馆的管理者有效建模并解决行人交互难题。
